items.q: How much space does the station need?
items.a: The station needs a compact spot against a wall. We match the exact dimensions to your venue in a free consultation.

If the station is hosted at your venue, we handle service, beans and refills. If you buy the station, we train your team and support you at launch. Daily cleaning is done automatically by the station.

items.q: Does it need power and water?
items.a: A standard 230 V socket is required. Whether a water connection is needed depends on the model — we’ll advise which option suits your venue.
Contract terms depend on the partnership model and the venue. You get an individual offer within 24 hours.
Guests pay by card, smartphone or coins — the terminal is built into the station. The billing model between us and the venue is agreed individually.

items.q: How quickly is the station installed?
items.a: It depends on the venue and the model. We deliver across Germany and agree the installation date right after the offer is accepted.
